profile.headline: SWE @ Visa
profile.summary:
I am a Full Stack Software Engineer at Visa.

As a graduate student at Georgia Tech and a technical intern at several companies, I gained practical experience in developing AI-driven systems and conducting research in linguistics and natural language processing. I’m passionate about designing innovative solutions and leveraging interdisciplinary expertise to solve complex problems. As a student, I conducted sociolinguistic research on a multidisciplinary team, using Python and R to analyze linguistic data. I also taught linguistics and Knowledge-Based AI concepts as a Graduate and Undergraduate Teaching Assistant, supporting student learning and curriculum development.

company.name: College of Computing at Georgia Tech

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Foster City, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Built a multi-agent workflow using LangGraph and LLMs (GPT-4.1, Claude 3.7) to auto-generate Workato recipes, enabling Visa systems to integrate with accounting software like Xero and QuickBooks—reducing onboarding time by 66%.

Developed a dynamic knowledge base of APIs, recipe patterns, and platform behaviors to support prompt-based recipe generation and automate complex integration tasks previously done manually.

Proposed a blockchain-based cross-border payment solution during Visa’s Global Case Challenge to streamline transactions in “challenger” markets, replacing SWIFT messaging and reducing costs and latency.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Graduate Teaching Assistant for CS 7637: Knowledge-Based AI under Dr. Ashok Goel in the School of Interactive Computing.

company.name: College of Computing at Georgia Tech

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Undergraduate Teaching Assistant for LING 2100, Introduction to Linguistics under Dr. Lelia Glass.

Graded assignments and exams, providing timely feedback, and answered student questions to facilitate understanding and success. 
Wrote exam and assignment questions to assess students' understanding of the class content.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
Conducted and transcribed sociolinguistic interviews to collect data on diachronic shift of the Southern accent and identity in Georgia.
Devised an automated method to upload large interview files to the Open Science Framework, allowing us to share our research with a wider scientific audience with much less time and effort.
Conducted statistical analysis and proving qualitative insights of collected linguistic data using Python and R.
Collaborated with other student researchers and led new students in their research.

Semesters participated:
Fall 2024
Spring 2024
Fall 2023

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a robust Python-based email classification system using fuzzy search algorithms, achieving 100% accuracy in classifying invoice emails based on similarity to known templates.
Significantly improved efficiency of downstream processes by enhancing system robustness, flexibility, and reliability in the same project, reducing misclassification and the need for human maintenance and intervention.
Authored comprehensive Cucumber tests in Gherkin for Javascript module, enhancing reliability of an automated payments system.
Leveraged learning and networking opportunities through Visa University and intern/new-hire programs to extend my understanding of the payment ecosystem and responsible use of Generative AI.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Cucumber · Gherken · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · Algorithm Analysis

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Undergraduate Teaching Assistant for LING 2100, Introduction to Linguistics under Dr. Hongchen Wu.

Graded assignments and exams, providing timely feedback, and answered student questions to facilitate understanding and success. 
Wrote exam and assignment questions to assess students' understanding of the class content.

positions.title: NREIP Intern
positions.description: Participated in a 10-week internship in order to solve technical problems using Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning techniques by attending lectures and completed hands-on programming assignments. Completed a final project to develop and train deep learning game playing algorithms to compete in a game of capture the flag.
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Reinforcement Learning · Game AI · Machine Learning · Deep Learning

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description:
Enhanced missile mission planning using MATLAB by developing features to visualize radar coverage at any altitude, implementing multiple graphical representations, and ensuring data integrity through defensive programming.

Developed modular trajectory plotting tools and optimal control utilization capability to improve dynamical systems modeling for threat trajectory analysis.

Led setup of GitLab CI/CD pipeline to facilitate streamlined code integration, maintenance, and testing.
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Data Visualization · Data Modeling · Python (Programming Language) · MATLAB

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Researched with the Natural Language Processing Lab (under Dr. Wei Xu) to annotate data for error identification for phrase-level text simplification models.

positions.title: SEAP Intern
positions.description:
Researched and implemented autonomous microrobotics control algorithms using electromagnetic technology.

Developed Python GUIs and converted control algorithms from MATLAB to Python. 

Assembled, installed, and tested PLA and SLA 3D printers.
positions.insights: Skills: Algorithm Optimization · Computer Science · Pycharm · 3D Printing · Mechanical Troubleshooting · Git · Python (Programming Language) · MATLAB

positions.title: ASPIRE Intern
positions.description:
Modernized and restructured internal networking website utilizing PHP, CSS, and HTML.

Resolved employee technical concerns as internal tech support.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Support · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · CSS Flexbox · CSS Grid Layout · Computer Science · Internal Communications · PHP · HTML

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Analyzed image data from magneto-optics experiments using MATLAB.

Originally awarded the internship through the United States Naval Academy SEAP Internship program, but SEAP was canceled due to COVID-19 measures. Independently worked with my SEAP mentor on his current projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Algorithm Optimization · Computer Vision · Computer Science · Pycharm · Digital Image Processing · MATLAB
